snippet.title: [Praise Dead] Corpses Awakened to Protect the Village
snippet.description:
GAME LINK : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459180/Praise_Dead/
My Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198041512403/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Praise Dead is a roguelike strategy game where you play as a necromancer defending a village by managing resources, raising zombies, and surviving for 21 days.

The game is divided into three phases—Maintenance, Work, and Battle—repeating daily in a cycle that tests how efficiently you build your undead army and manage your town. During the Maintenance phase, you use village buildings to buy organs, craft zombies, and collect equipment or relics. Each organ has five stats, and the combination of organs determines the zombie’s attributes.

In the Work phase, zombies are assigned to tasks that generate gold, iron, food, energy, or build barricades and rescue villagers. Task efficiency varies depending on stat relevance and placement order, so strategic zombie allocation is key.

In the Battle phase, you deploy zombies to defend against enemy invasions, using energy to cast spells that increase stats or deal damage. If all zombies fall, enemies breach the barricades and harm villagers—losing all villagers results in a game over. Victory, on the other hand, earns gold and relics, with bosses dropping unique powerful items.

Defeating the final boss on Day 21 completes the run. Souls earned across playthroughs can be spent on upgrades to improve starting conditions and unlock bonuses. With a strong synergy between zombie creation, resource planning, and tactical battles, Praise Dead delivers a fresh twist on the necromancer survival formula.
